name: A Gentle Rain

categories.label: Blossoms opened
categories.hint: One blossom opens each time a 2x2 square of touching tiles is completed. All 8 lily types must bloom to win.

categories.label: Unplayed tiles left
categories.hint: Tiles remaining in the stack when the 8th blossom opens; discarded tiles do not count.

winCondition: Solo: win by getting all 8 lily types to bloom before the tile stack runs out; the score (blossoms + tiles left) measures how well.

endCondition.description: Ends when all 8 blossoms are open or the tiles run out.

notes: family: solo-tile-laying. Score formula (1 per blossom + 1 per unplayed tile; discarded tiles score nothing) inferred from BGG designer/player forum answers (e.g. 8 blossoms + 4 tiles left = 12); official rulebook PDF could not be downloaded, so numbers should be checked against the rulebook.

sources.title: BGG forum: Do the discarded tiles influence my score?
BGG solo review: goal is 8 blooms with as many tiles left as possible
